outcome: Characteristics of mistreatment during childbirth (physical abuse, sexual abuse, verbal abuse, failure to meet professional standards, poor rapport between women and providers, health system conditions)
cohort: Postpartum women who delivered in two Israeli hospitals.
finding: A considerable prevalence of mistreatment during childbirth was found in Israeli medical centers, with failure to meet professional standards (51.9%) and poor rapport (33.2%) being the most common categories.
mod_finding: Cesarean section and planned birth mode were significantly associated with mistreatment during childbirth.
